info.name: Dispatch API (POST /dispatch, GET /dispatch/{dispatchId}, POST /dispatch/batch/get, POST /dispatch/{dispatchId}/assign-driver, PUT /dispatch/{dispatchId}, DELETE /dispatch/{dispatchId})
info.description: Scenario coverage for POST /auth/login, POST /dispatch, GET /dispatch/{dispatchId}, POST /dispatch/batch/get, POST /dispatch/{dispatchId}/assign-driver, PUT /dispatch/{dispatchId}, and DELETE /dispatch/{dispatchId}: success paths, FluentValidation-driven 400s (via the ValidationException -> 400 exception handler in Program.cs), ASP.NET model-binding 400s (malformed/missing JSON), the 404 KeyNotFoundException path for GetDispatch/AssignDriver/UpdateDispatch/DeleteDispatch, the partial-failure Found/NotFound split for GetDispatchBatch, the ArgumentException -> 400 path for AssignDriver (missing carrier / unknown or inactive driver) and UpdateDispatch (immutable Make/Model/Year mismatch, VehicleId not on this dispatch), and the ValidationException -> 400 path for UpdateDispatch (status Canceled/Delivered/PendingDelivery) and DeleteDispatch (status already Delivered). All dispatch endpoints require auth -- POST /dispatch needs [Authorize(Policy = PermissionNames.DispatchesCreate)], the GET-style endpoints need [Authorize(Policy = PermissionNames.DispatchesRead)], PUT and assign-driver need [Authorize(Policy = PermissionNames.DispatchesUpdate)], and DELETE needs [Authorize(Policy = PermissionNames.DispatchesDelete)]. Run the Auth > Login request first (or via Collection Runner, which executes folders top-to-bottom) so {{authToken}} is populated before any dispatch request runs. Run both Success > 'Valid request, 1 vehicle -> 201' and 'Valid request, Description omitted -> 201' before the Get Dispatch / Get Dispatch Batch / Assign Driver / Update Dispatch / Delete Dispatch folders so {{dispatchId}}, {{dispatchId2}}, and {{vehicleId2}} are populated. Set {{driverId}} to a seeded/registered active user's UserId before running Assign Driver. Update Dispatch is placed AFTER Assign Driver deliberately: its status-gate 400 case relies on {{dispatchId}} already being PendingDelivery (set by AssignDriverAsync as a side effect), while its success/reconciliation cases use {{dispatchId2}}, which Assign Driver never touches. The Delete Dispatch folder is placed LAST in this collection because it cancels {{dispatchId}} (clearing its vehicles/stops/drivers) -- running it earlier would break the Get Dispatch / Get Dispatch Batch / Assign Driver assertions that expect that dispatch to still have its original data.

variable.description: Set to a seeded/registered user's UserName with the dispatches:create permission before running this collection.
Set by Success > 'Valid request, 1 vehicle -> 201'; used by the Get Dispatch and Get Dispatch Batch folders.
Set by Success > 'Valid request, Description omitted -> 201'; used by the Get Dispatch Batch and Update Dispatch folders.
Set by Success > 'Valid request, Description omitted -> 201'; the original vehicle on dispatchId2, used by Update Dispatch to confirm it's preserved (not deleted) across updates.
Set by Update Dispatch > 'Add a new vehicle while keeping existing -> 200'; the newly-added vehicle's id (coexists with vehicleId2), used by later Update Dispatch requests.
Set to a seeded/registered active user's UserId (e.g. TestUserSeedIds.UserId) before running the Assign Driver folder. No dedicated 'driver' role check is performed by AssignDriver beyond IsActive.

Optional. There is no endpoint yet to move a dispatch to Delivered status, so to exercise Delete Dispatch's 400 case, manually run `UPDATE dispatches SET dispatch_status = 'Delivered' WHERE dispatch_id = '<id>'` against your local DB for any existing dispatch, then set this variable to that id before running 'Delete a Delivered dispatch -> 400'.

item.name: Update Dispatch (PUT /dispatch/{dispatchId})
item.description: Covers UpdateDispatch: 200 on success (updates Price/Dates/Description/Stops, and reconciles Vehicles), 400 for Vehicles-array-level failures (count, duplicate VehicleId, duplicate-via-omitted-VehicleId), 400 for per-vehicle field failures (Make/Model/Year required, Year range, Vin length -- these apply to EVERY vehicle in the array, not just new ones), 400 for a VehicleId that belongs to a different dispatch, 400 (ValidationException, DispatchStatus field) when the dispatch's status is Canceled/Delivered/PendingDelivery, and 404 for an unknown dispatch. Uses {{dispatchId2}}/{{vehicleId2}} (untouched by Assign Driver) for the success/reconciliation cases, and {{dispatchId}} (already PendingDelivery after Assign Driver ran) for the status-gate case -- see the collection-level description for why this folder is ordered after Assign Driver. IMPORTANT -- behavior notes for this DTO shape: (1) VehicleId is a required (non-nullable) field on every vehicle entry, new or existing. A vehicle is only treated as 'existing' if its VehicleId matches a row in the Vehicles table ANYWHERE in the database (not scoped to this dispatch) -- an unrecognized VehicleId is silently treated as a brand-new vehicle rather than erroring, while a VehicleId belonging to a genuinely different dispatch fails with 'does not belong to this dispatch'. (2) A missing VehicleId defaults to an empty guid, so sending two or more new vehicles in the same request without explicit distinct ids collides on the Duplicate-VehicleId rule -- always generate a fresh guid client-side for each new vehicle. (3) Make/Model/Year/Vin rules apply to every vehicle in the array, existing or new: Vin (if present) must be 10-15 chars, Year (if present) must be 1900..currentYear, and Make/Model/Year are all required -- even when only updating Vin/Color on an existing vehicle. (4) Make/Model/Year are no longer immutable on existing vehicles; they can be changed freely. (5) Vehicles use full-replace semantics -- any existing vehicle whose VehicleId is not present in the request's vehicles array is DELETED. Success-case prerequest scripts fetch the dispatch's current vehicles first (carrying forward vin/year/make/model/color) and include all of them in the payload to avoid wiping out vehicles you didn't mean to touch, and to satisfy the now-mandatory per-vehicle fields.
